legislation.title: Seventeenth Amendment
legislation.supporters: Progressive reformers; Senator Joseph L. Bristow (substitute amendment)
legislation.opponents: Supporters of the race rider (individual names unverified)
legislation.supportArguments: Direct elections address legislative deadlock and corruption; Bristow substitute removes race rider.
legislation.oppositionArguments: Race-rider proponents asserted state sovereignty; opponents of the rider argued it would undermine Black voting rights.
legislation.amendments: Bristow substitute without the race rider adopted by Senate in May 1911; House accepted May 13, 1912.
